_note: Report header every flow agent's hand-back starts with (report_schema.py parses it, report-check.py enforces it at PreToolUse SubagentHandback, flow-next.py reads only these fields). Header = the report's first lines, one `FIELD: value` per line, up to the first line that isn't a field. `required`: always; `when_done`: when STATUS is DONE; `when_changes`: when VERDICT is CHANGES REQUESTED, at least one of these fields not `none`. `max_denials`: hand-backs denied per agent before report-check lets one through (flow-next then stops with needs-decision), so a model that can't comply doesn't loop.
